scope: 196 representation-family genitive plurals, one bibliographic title noun, and 23 proof-ending formulas.
choice: Use official genitive plural prědstavjenij rather than inherited zero-ending prědstavjenj; recast the title's mental-image noun prědstava as mathematical prědstavjenje with agreeing case; replace Russian-calqued čto bylo dokazati by tym jest dokazano.
motivation: The pinned official morphology generator maps the -ńj- noun root to genitive plural -nij. All 196 contexts are genitive plural. Official prědstava means notion/mental image and is semantically wrong in the title about mathematical representation. The transparent proof close removes an avoidable Russian syntactic calque.
alternatives_rejected: Retain the systemic but noncanonical zero genitive plural.
Keep a wrong mental-image lexeme in a mathematical title.
Preserve Russian QED syntax as a fixed reader formula.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references, braces, and math delimiters unchanged
validation.outputs: dry-run hashes frozen before write and reproduced after write
